items.title: Terry Clark — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I remember Milt Hinton and Mona. It was a beautiful occasion.

ctx.x: I don’t know if Pearl was there or not. But I remember Milt Hinton and Mona. It was a beautiful occasion.
How do you – I think it was 19 – I want to say – 78 when Jimmy Carter did his – did a big party at the White House, I guess it was.
